title: Steps to Broadway + Music Hall • Modern Condo
description:
Welcome to Mic Drop by AvantStay. Set squarely in the middle of downtown, this bold, playful two-bedroom puts your crew two minutes from Broadway's neon — close enough to catch the honky-tonks warming up, far enough to duck out when you've had your fill.

🎸 Two-minute walk to Broadway & Printer's Alley
🛏️ King bedroom + king-over-king bunk with trundle
🍳 Full kitchen with bar seating & a workstation

The space
Mic Drop is a two-bedroom condo for groups who came to be where it's all happening. Step out the door and Broadway's neon and live music are about a two-minute walk away — close enough to catch the honky-tonks warming up, far enough to duck out when you've had your fill. Printer's Alley, with its speakeasy energy and late-night shows, sits just up the block.

Inside, the mood is bold and a little playful. The living room is the group's home base — easygoing seating, a smart TV, and a coffee table that pulls double duty for board games, takeout, and everything in between. A sleeper sofa adds a crash spot for the night owls, and the open layout keeps everyone in on the conversation, even when someone's holding court in the kitchen. That kitchen is fully set up to feed a crew: full-size fridge, oven, four-burner stove, dishwasher, drip coffee, and bar seating for five for morning bites or post-Broadway snacks.

The two bedrooms handle the whole group. The primary keeps things classic with a king bed, while the second room leans into the fun — a king-over-king bunk with a trundle, the kind of setup that turns a trip with friends into a grown-up sleepover. A built-in work station tucked into the second bedroom covers anyone who has to check in with real life. A full bath with a shower/tub combo plus a convenient half bath keep the morning rotation moving.

The location is the real headliner. Beyond Broadway and Printer's Alley, you're within an easy walk of the Johnny Cash Museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame, Assembly Food Hall, and Bridgestone Arena, where the Predators play and the big shows land. When you'd rather roam, The Gulch, Germantown, Music Row, and 12 South are all short drives out, and Vanderbilt, Centennial Park, and the Parthenon aren't far behind. From first coffee to last encore, Mic Drop keeps the best of Music City right outside the door.

In the heart of downtown Nashville, The Saddlery puts you within a few blocks of both Broadway and Printer's Alley — one of the most walkable, most coveted addresses in the city. This is downtown the way you'd actually want to do it: live music and honky-tonks one direction, tucked-away bars and late-night eateries the other, rooftop views and local favorites filling in everywhere between. Inside, thoughtfully designed units give you somewhere just as good to come back to — a place to slow down and regroup between the nights out. And when the whole crew's in town, units can be booked together, so larger groups can spread out while staying right next door to one another.

There's a reason Nashville, TN has become one of the country's most loved southern cities. With its vibrant nightlife, country music scene, and incredible food, "Nashvegas" is a top destination for people simply looking to have a good time- which means lots of drinking and eating. Visitors flock to Broadway, a street lined with multi-level bars playing live music and serving BBQ. You might get stuck in traffic behind party bikes called Pedal Taverns, but you're more likely to cheer them on than get road rage because having fun is part of the culture in Nashville.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- 5th-floor unit — there's an elevator on-site, so no hauling bags up the stairs.
- You're in the heart of downtown, and it lives up to it. Expect city energy: music, crowds, sirens, and the occasional construction sound come with a location this central.
- The second bedroom's beds are a king-over-king bunk with a trundle — a fun setup, but worth a heads-up for anyone who'd prefer not to take the top bunk.
- Booking guest must be at least 21 years old.
- Local bookings aren't accepted — guests whose primary residence is within two hours of the property can't reserve this home.
- Identity verification (name, address, phone, and photo ID) is required within 48 hours of booking.
- No parties, events, or weddings.
- Starter kits for the kitchen and bathrooms are a courtesy to get your stay going and aren't restocked mid-trip.
- The building offers both stair and elevator access to all Saddlery units.
- Please note that individual units may vary slightly in design, location, and views. Photos are representative and may not reflect the exact unit booked.
- There's no washer or dryer in the unit, but a laundromat is located nearby for anyone who needs to freshen up a few things during a longer stay.

Parking Info:
- There's no dedicated on-site parking at the building.
- Paid parking lots are available nearby.
- Paid street parking is also an option.

[DISCLAIMERS]
  - No smoking in or outside of this home. Subject to a $500 fine.
  - Occupancy and noise limits are strongly enforced. Subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.
  - IDs and security deposits when applicable will be requested after booking
  - We have the right to report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
